set.body: The response/archive convergence is unreleased (0.1.0-SNAPSHOT) and must not preserve earlier in-repository APIs as legacy compatibility. Remove the deprecated LatentArchiveCodec alias and LegacyLatentArchiveCodec central dispatcher; route production callers through explicit representation encoders/families; name retained on-disk LNA translation by schema version rather than legacy status; remove the un-enveloped compatibility family unless a current typed LNA representation owns it; update guards, fixtures, and documentation. Acceptance: no legacy-named response/archive production API or central representation dispatch remains, versioned format handling is explicit, numerical fixtures remain regression evidence, affected JVM/JS suites and Phase-8 boundaries pass, compileAll/testAll pass, and unrelated work is preserved.
set.title: Remove pre-release response/archive compatibility layer
